source.note: Bank's own internships page for the qualifications, and its main careers page for the hiring-process statement; each field cites the page it came from.

class_year.quote: Current undergraduate or graduate student; should have at least one semester left to complete in school.

process.quote: The selection process may include one or more interviews with human resources and the department hiring team.

cooling_off.quote: You may apply for more than one position, submitting a separate application for each one
cooling_off.notes: Permissive: the Bank states that a candidate may hold more than one live application, one per position. It appears in the 'What to expect in the hiring process' list on the main careers page, not on the internships page, and is cited to the page that carries it. It addresses concurrent applications rather than reapplying after a rejection, and nothing is inferred about the latter.

unfiled_quotes.quote: Able to work 40 hours per week for the duration of a 10- to 12-week internship that starts as early as May and ends as late as September.
Note: Relatives of current Cleveland Fed employees or directors will not be considered for internships.
Our paid summer interns are full-time college students pursuing undergrad and graduate degrees.

provenance.origin: Bank's own internships and careers pages
provenance.note: Sponsorship is silent: neither page contains 'citizen', 'visa', 'CPT', 'OPT', 'sponsor' or 'work authorization'. That is a notable silence rather than a routine one, because the Federal Reserve Board and the Atlanta Fed both state a citizenship position plainly, and this Bank does not. Recording it as silent says only that the Bank publishes nothing on the point.
